name: Unone Scatter
description: Scatter trees, grass, rocks and props over an area or a heightfield: evenly spaced random points filtered by height, slope and your own rule, packed for api.instances3d.set. A pure, deterministic Luau module installed beside your scripts.

tools.name: plugin.test
tools.title: Check the module
tools.description: Check that the bundled Luau module is present.

tools.name: scatter.describe
tools.title: Describe the module
tools.description: The Luau API: Scatter.points(options), Scatter.heightAt(field, x, z) and Scatter.pack(points), with every option.

tools.name: scatter.install
tools.title: Install the module
tools.description: Copy unone-scatter.luau beside the project's entry script, so game code can require("./unone-scatter"). Refuses to overwrite an edited copy unless force is true.
